# Inspect 1:1 launch cut in browser

> Inspect the square contact sheet's measured format, timing, hero and detail visuals, exact copy, wordmark reveal and closing call to action.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 in the browser and wait for the Kestrel Runner square contact sheet to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4

Inspect the square sheet header's cut metadata and declared shot intervals, then assert 1080×1080 at 30 fps for 12 seconds with hero 0:00–0:03, detail 0:03–0:07 and call to action 0:07–0:12.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-6, ac-7

Inspect the labelled 0:00 hero frame on the square sheet, then assert a dark night-city backdrop and exact caption “Run the city”.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-8, ac-9, ac-11

Inspect the labelled 0:03 detail frame and its facts-table rows on the square sheet, then assert a close-up orange sole in the hero frame's teal-and-orange colourway, no visible KESTREL wordmark, and exact price-tag text “€149”.

## Step 5 @verifies ac-10

Inspect the labelled 0:05 detail frame on the square sheet, then assert the KESTREL wordmark is fully visible.

## Step 6 @verifies ac-12, ac-13

Inspect the labelled 0:07 closing frame and its facts-table rows on the square sheet, then assert exact headline text “Out 28 November” and button label “Get early access”.

## Step 7 @verifies ac-16

Inspect every visible text-layer row for all labelled frames in the square sheet's facts table, then assert each has fully-inside-frame true.

# Inspect 9:16 launch cut in browser

> Inspect the vertical contact sheet's measured format, timing, hero and detail visuals, exact copy, wordmark reveal and closing call to action.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and wait for the vertical Kestrel Runner contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4

Inspect the vertical sheet header's measured cut metadata and declared shot intervals, then assert 1080×1920 at 30 fps for 12 seconds with hero 0:00–0:03, detail 0:03–0:07, and call to action 0:07–0:12.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-6, ac-7

Inspect the labelled 0:00 hero frame on the vertical sheet, then assert a dark night-city backdrop and the exact caption “Run the city”.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-8, ac-9, ac-11

Inspect the labelled 0:03 detail frame and its facts-table rows on the vertical sheet, then assert a close-up orange sole retaining the hero frame's teal-and-orange colourway, no visible KESTREL wordmark, and exact price-tag text “€149”.

## Step 5 @verifies ac-10

Inspect the labelled 0:05 detail frame on the vertical sheet, then assert the KESTREL wordmark is fully visible.

## Step 6 @verifies ac-12, ac-13

Inspect the labelled 0:07 call-to-action frame and its facts-table rows on the vertical sheet, then assert exact headline text “Out 28 November” and button label “Get early access”.

## Step 7 @verifies ac-14

On the vertical contact sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect the top shaded band across every labelled frame, then assert no text or button occupies the top 14% of any frame.

## Step 8 @verifies ac-15

On the vertical contact sheet with safe zones shown, inspect the bottom shaded band across every labelled frame, then assert no text or button occupies the bottom 35% of any frame.

## Step 9 @verifies ac-16

Inspect all visible text layers in the vertical sheet's per-frame facts table, then assert every one has fully-inside-frame true.

# Inspect shot handoffs and wordmark milestone

> Inspect the three cuts at the 0:03 and 0:07 shot handoffs and the 0:05 wordmark milestone against the declared shot intervals.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the Kestrel Runner widescreen contact sheet to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4, ac-9, ac-10

Inspect the widescreen sheet's header and labelled 0:03, 0:05 and 0:07 frames, then assert 1920×1080 at 30 fps for 12 seconds, declared hero 0:00–0:03, detail 0:03–0:07 and call to action 0:07–0:12, with no visible KESTREL wordmark at 0:03 and a fully visible one by 0:05.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4, ac-9, ac-10

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 and inspect its header and labelled 0:03, 0:05 and 0:07 frames after the sheet shows ready, then assert 1080×1920 at 30 fps for 12 seconds, the same declared shot intervals, no visible KESTREL wordmark at 0:03 and a fully visible one by 0:05.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4, ac-9, ac-10

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 and inspect its header and labelled 0:03, 0:05 and 0:07 frames after the sheet shows ready, then assert 1080×1080 at 30 fps for 12 seconds, the same declared shot intervals, no visible KESTREL wordmark at 0:03 and a fully visible one by 0:05.

# Reject bottom-band intrusion in 9:16 cut

> Prove no visible text or button occupies the bottom 35% in any 9:16 contact-sheet frame.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and wait for the Kestrel Runner vertical contact sheet to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-15

On the 9:16 sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect every labelled frame against the shaded bottom band, then assert no text or button occupies the bottom 35% of any frame.

> For every cut, inspect every frame's visible text-layer fully-inside-frame fact and catch any clipped text.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the Kestrel Runner widescreen contact sheet to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-16

Inspect every visible text-layer row for every labelled frame in the widescreen sheet's facts table, then assert each has fully-inside-frame true.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-16

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 and inspect every visible text-layer row for every labelled frame in its facts table after the sheet shows ready, then assert each has fully-inside-frame true.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-16

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 and inspect every visible text-layer row for every labelled frame in its facts table after the sheet shows ready, then assert each has fully-inside-frame true.
